\section*{AP \({ }^{\text {® }}\) CALCULUS BC \\ 2011 SCORING GUIDELINES}

\section*{Question 1}

At time \(t\), a particle moving in the \(x y\)-plane is at position \((x(t), y(t))\), where \(x(t)\) and \(y(t)\) are not explicitly given. For \(t \geq 0, \frac{d x}{d t}=4 t+1\) and \(\frac{d y}{d t}=\sin \left(t^{2}\right)\). At time \(t=0, x(0)=0\) and \(y(0)=-4\).
\begin{itemize}
\item[(a)] Find the speed of the particle at time \(t=3\), and find the acceleration vector of the particle at time \(t=3\).
\item[(b)] Find the slope of the line tangent to the path of the particle at time \(t=3\).
\item[(c)] Find the position of the particle at time \(t=3\).
\item[(d)] Find the total distance traveled by the particle over the time interval \(0 \leq t \leq 3\).
\item[(a)] Speed \(=\sqrt{\left(x^{\prime}(3)\right)^{2}+\left(y^{\prime}(3)\right)^{2}}=13.006\) or 13.007
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text { Acceleration } & =\left\langle x^{\prime \prime}(3), y^{\prime \prime}(3)\right\rangle \\
& =\langle 4,-5.466\rangle \text { or }\langle 4,-5.467\rangle
\end{aligned}
\]
\item[(b)] Slope \(=\frac{y^{\prime}(3)}{x^{\prime}(3)}=0.031\) or 0.032
\item[(c)] \(x(3)=0+\int_{0}^{3} \frac{d x}{d t} d t=21\)
\[
y(3)=-4+\int_{0}^{3} \frac{d y}{d t} d t=-3.226
\]
At time \(t=3\), the particle is at position (21, -3.226).
\item[(d)] Distance \(=\int_{0}^{3} \sqrt{\left(\frac{d x}{d t}\right)^{2}+\left(\frac{d y}{d t}\right)^{2}} d t=21.091\)
\end{itemize}
\(2:\left\{\begin{array}{l}1: \text { speed } \\ 1: \text { acceleration }\end{array}\right.\)
